name: Bro swapping and selection
description: Covers swap_bro, with and without nextSpawn, and list_bros over vanilla, Expendabros and unfinished names, case and spacing mismatches, an unlocked custom bro, a custom bro locked in memory (Cobro) with and without ignoreUnlocks, an already-held bro, an unknown name and out-of-range player numbers, the respawn after a plain and a bypass swap, the reply's roster broName and objectName, a bro the game holds refused, a swap keeping the save's hero unlocks and playing no unlock cutscene, a locked custom bro left out by Filter Bros with ignoreUnlocks, nextSpawn on a level that forces its bros, a swap Swap Bros Mod reports that the slot does not hold, one the slot loses within half a second, an incompatible Swap Bros Mod and a Swap Bros Mod lookup made again once lost, the reason each failure carries (no-player on an empty slot here, no-level in game-states.json), and swap-bros-missing and swap-failed, produced by hiding the integration's Swap Bros Mod in memory and by switching off Swap Bros Mod's enabled flag and selection array for one call each. Needs a loaded level, Swap Bros Mod with BroMaker enabled, alwaysChosen on and the custom bro installed and unlocked. Its first steps undo whatever an earlier run left changed, and its last steps unlock the bro again, restore the Swap Bros settings and anything those calls left switched off and reload the level it started in. Locking the bro never touches its saved unlock progress. Its cleanup runs the restore again whatever ended the steps: the lock, the Swap Bros settings, the hidden integration, Swap Bros Mod's enabled flag and selection array, the second player, IronBro, pause and speed.
